title: Primitive Radix Dynamics: research and reproducibility companion
description: Exact proof records, verification software, certificates, provenance ledgers and epistemic navigation supporting the forthcoming article ‘A Sharp Permutation Threshold for Finite High Components in Primitive Radix–Möbius Dynamics’. The manuscript is intentionally excluded during the pre-arXiv embargo.
